verdict.rationale: Codegen's own first-party Slack App lets the agent send notifications, ask for clarification (the needs-input case) and report progress directly in Slack channels. It can also update statuses and add comments in Linear, Jira and similar trackers, which surfaces task progress to the developer. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a task-completion notification event, configurable notification settings or channels, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get notified when an agent completes a task or needs my input

citations.quote: Send notifications, ask for clarification, report progress, and interact directly with your team in Slack channels.
Add the Codegen Slack App to communicate with the agent directly in your workspace.
